text:
Lina: Heads-up flying into Toronto next week, staying near King & Spadina. Any easy dinner recs that's casual and good for 4?
Omar: King & Spadina = tons of options. Try KINKA for izakaya vibes, or Pai for Thai (a bit of a walk).
Ben: If you want poutine nearby, La Banquise is solid but may be a cab. For tacos, Seven Lives is small but 🔥.
Lina: Sweet. Also any nice brunch spots that take reservations? arriving Sunday morning.
Omar: For brunch that takes resos, Mildred's Temple Kitchen is reliable. Otherwise, early line at Bonjour Brioche for pastries.
Ben: If you're gluten-free, Maker Pizza does GF slices and is chill for groups.
food-bot: Toronto picks added to Redwood travel notes: KINKA, Mildred's, La Banquise, Seven Lives.
Lina: Awesome, thanks. Switching coast  anyone in SF this week? craving ramen and maybe a late snack run.
Omar: I'm remote but in SF Fri. Ramen spot I'd hit: Mensho Tokyo in SoMa, or Ramen Yamadaya for tonkotsu.
Ben: Late snack? theres a ramen pop-up on 3rd this week open till midnight. Also, Mikuni Sushi has late happy hour.
Lina: Does anyone want to join a food-truck lunch on Thu 12:15? I can place one order and split. @Ben @Omar
Ben: I'm in :white_check_mark: prefer something veg-friendly.
Omar: :white_check_mark: will bring cash.
Lina: Cool. Side Q: any hotel recs near King & Spadina that's quiet-ish? not a nightclub next door.
Ben: The Broadview Hotel is nice and quieter side streets. Also the Delta near the waterfront is more business-y.
Omar: For budget, the Gladstone can be artsy but noisy on weekends.
food-bot: Lunch poll created: "Food-truck Thu 12:15?" react with :white_check_mark: for yes.
Lina: Last thing  any Montreal stops worth detouring for if you're in Toronto? (thinking smoked meat or bagels)
Ben: St-Viateur Bagel and Schwartz's Deli for smoked meat are classics if you can swing the trip.
Omar: If you like pastries, stop at Patisserie Rhubarbe.
Lina: Perfect. I'll pin these and DM the group about the order. cheers :raised_hands:
